preImageRead: Existing long: entry 86,289.01, 99.77x, notional 931.73, collateral 9.34, liquidation 85,657.61. Recommended a manual stop around 86,250 and to wait for a 1m close below it. Chart structure was treated as the primary stop constraint.
missingFeature: No position-risk math: nothing solved stop distance %, dollar loss at the stop, loss as % of collateral, distance to liquidation, or whether the stop executes intrabar, before a stop was named. Thesis invalidation and the hard protective stop were not separated.
postImageRead: 86,289.01 → 86,250 is ~0.045% of price, ~0.42 USD before fees and slippage, already ~4.5% of the 9.34 collateral. Any structural invalidation more than ~0.7% away sits past liquidation at ~100x, so the position is overleveraged for that thesis: reduce leverage or size, never tighten the thesis. At ~100x the protective stop must be a pre-set executable price, not a 1m close.
fixLocation: API risk engine (lib/riskEngine.js: positionRisk, maxStopDistanceForBudget, stopHierarchy); attached to account.positions[] in Phase 3b.
proposedFeature: positionRisk / stopHierarchy: protective stop always before liquidation with fee and slippage allowance, thesis invalidation kept separate, compatible:false with a recommended leverage when structure needs more room than the loss budget.
